checks.output:
usage: verify_confined.py [-h] --output OUTPUT
                          [--repository-root REPOSITORY_ROOT]
                          [--limit-seconds LIMIT_SECONDS]
                          [--case {narrow_door_eastbound,narrow_door_westbound,foyer_south_wall_turn}]
                          [--wall-pose {geometry-clear,original}]

Verify a narrow doorway and turn-space rejection using the real CPU G1 policy.
WorldSim owns the only physics clock; no renderer, ports, pose pinning or
replacement gait is used. Each independent initial pose is set by normal
reset.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT
  --repository-root REPOSITORY_ROOT
                        NERV root; override only when running the temporary
                        candidate
  --limit-seconds LIMIT_SECONDS
  --case {narrow_door_eastbound,narrow_door_westbound,foyer_south_wall_turn}
  --wall-pose {geometry-clear,original}
                        Measured body-envelope clearance, or the rejected
                        original initial point
